allocationStatus.title: Allocation Status
allocationStatus.description: Optional filter: e.g. Approved or Pending.

allocationType.title: Allocation Type
allocationType.description: Optional filter: Secured, Likely, or Pipeline.

country.title: Country
country.description: Country of the Budget Lines, e.g. Kenya. Reuse the country already resolved in the conversation.

fiscalYear.title: Fiscal Year
fiscalYear.description: Fiscal year, e.g. 2027. Reuse the year already resolved in the conversation; defaults to the current scenario when omitted.

opportunityName.title: Opportunity Name
opportunityName.description: Optional: limit to one Opportunity by name.

program.title: Program
program.description: The Headroom category / program, e.g. Core Program, Trees. Reuse the category already resolved in the conversation.

showAll.title: Show All
showAll.description: Set true when the user explicitly asks for the full list ('show all', 'list every allocation'). Forces the complete list even beyond the summary threshold (bounded by a response-size safety limit).
